synopsis: University student Mimi and her boyfriend Naoto encounter one chilling mystery after another. There’s the enigmatic neighbor woman dressed in black from head to toe—but if she’s so odd, why does it seems like there are many others like her? Then, whose eyes track Mimi’s movements from the cemetery next door? And why does a bizarre red circle drawn on a basement wall change with each passing day? Nine scary stories that really happened, drawn from the famed collection of urban legends Shin Mimibukuro (New Earmuffs), and adapted into manga by horror genius Junji Ito! Chapter 1: On the Utility Pole Chapter 2: The Woman Next Door Chapter 3: Rustling in the Grass Chapter 4: Grave Placement Chapter 5: Seashore Chapter 6: Just the Two of Us Chapter 7: Scarlet Circle Chapter 8: Sign in the Field Chapter 9: Monster Prop (Source: VIZ Media)

synopsis: Ye Xi was an ordinary girl, nothing special. She wasn't the worst at anything, but she was never the best either. She was as invisible as air, practically invisible. Until she met Li Zhao… Li Zhao had her own goals; she wanted to become a top fashion designer. From a young age, every step she took was a step closer to her dream. “Clothing can not only change a person's temperament, but also give them boundless confidence,” this saying inspired Ye Xi to embark on her own fashion design journey. She wondered, what kind of transformation could this path bring her? Fortunately, she wasn't alone on this journey. She gained two good friends: the sweet-looking, dramatic Bai Xiaotao and the academically gifted Sun Zhiya. This is the story of a group of girls who met through fashion and are pursuing their dreams, occasionally interspersed with some lighthearted and silly everyday moments!

synopsis: An empire falling to ruin: The Kio Empire. Living in that empire, is an overweight 5-year-old abandoned by his parents, Prince Ageha. Ageha has memories from a previous life of him living as a Japanese man in another world. He then encounters his younger half-brother, Regulus. Ageha had a vision that Regulus will kill him in the future over inheritance, so Ageha sets out to raise him after Regulus's mother passed. Once the sparkling and fluffy-haired Regulus cozied up to Ageha, He turned into a doting older brother before he even realized! synopsis: Forever Haunted A boy sits in a room. Alone. Telling tales of horror. One by one. Night by night. The shadows breed terror. Shall we begin? One day, an elementary school child named Yuuma tries to jump out of his classroom window. His classmate Hina stops him and, in a bid to stall for time, asks him, “Do you know the round of a hundred ghost stories?” Hina tells Yuuma about a ritual where, if you tell a hundred ghost stories, you’ll see ghosts afterward. Learning this gives Yuuma a new lease on life. Chapter by chapter, he shares ghost stories with the reader, slowly but surely inching his way toward one hundred… (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

synonyms: Still, I want to make you happy
synopsis: Kouya is reunited with Aihime, a girl he used to play with when they were little, for the first time in nine years. Even though they've lived far apart, Kouya's feelings for her have been growing through their social media exchanges, and he decided to take the opportunity of their reunion to reveal his feelings to her! But she has a secret...? (Source: Manga Cross, translated) Note: Includes 4 extra chapters.
